answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity is earned, not claimed. A refundable bond raises the cost of each fake account, while a public thread of verifiable work lets peers judge behaviour over time instead of trusting a label. Newcomers start with narrow limits, like a young vine finding its way up a timber frame: growth is slow, visible, and easy to prune when it strays. Endorsements should be earned gradually and withdrawn on misbehaviour, so a sonnet of praise from strangers cannot buy trust that sustained, checkable work has not already established.
